objective: Re-measure interaction-local negative, zero, and positive values with direct post-projection adapter scaling after the zero-arm semantics repair.
hypothesis: The repaired direct operator retains non-degenerate negative, zero, and positive development support without projection-bias leakage through the zero arm.
falsification_criterion: Training remains blocked if any arm has fewer than four best-arm labels, any zero route emits a nonzero residual, any negative endpoint is not the signed counterpart of the positive operator, or any local intervention changes a pre-target interaction.

checkpoint.role: Frozen C3 multiscale adapter weights interpreted by the repaired complete-residual scale operator

invariants: scale is applied to the complete projected residual, including projection bias and future-frame bias
zero dose produces exact zero residuals on every invocation
negative and positive direct endpoints are signed operator counterparts
negative and positive doses activate only at the selected interaction
all pre-target interaction L1 values remain equal to the zero trajectory
runtime features come only from the direct zero-dose trajectory
episode 1799 is absent from features, labels, calibration, coverage selection, and training

local_return.definition: For interaction i and arm a, loss_i(a) is weighted suffix mean L1 plus terminal-interaction final-frame L1 plus suffix horizon-L1 slope. Value_i(a) is loss_i(zero)-loss_i(a).
local_return.target_rule: Choose the higher-value nonzero arm only when its value is at least 0.01; otherwise choose zero.

data_admission.coverage_definition: Fraction of repaired direct local decisions whose oracle target is a nonzero arm.
data_admission.failure_action: Do not retrain D1-D4. Return to mechanism redesign or expand development-only endpoints.

artifact_policy: Never overwrite outputs. Retain identity-bearing development shards only for audit and emit a separate anonymous training bank.
post_admission_authority: Create and run a new D1-D4 64-step screen only. No 512-step confirmation is authorized.
claim_boundary: Development-only operator repair and local counterfactual admission. It makes no held-out or dataset-level improvement claim.
